title.en: Centre design on audience tasks and devices

explanation.zh: 设备图展示同一电商内容在电脑、平板与手机上的呈现，末页强调为真正使用并购买的目标受众设计。应检查在不同屏幕上能否理解内容、浏览和行动；展示多个设备并不自动证明所有任务已经可用。
explanation.en: The device image shows e-commerce content on computers, tablets and phones; the final slide says to design for the audience that will use and purchase from the site. Check comprehension, browsing and action across screens; showing devices does not by itself prove usable task completion.

title.zh: 网站目标—策略—持续关系
title.en: Website objectives, strategies and continuing relationships

title.zh: 吸引访问：营销信息与落地页连接
title.en: Attracting visits: connect marketing messages to destination pages

explanation.zh: 目标—策略表将“吸引访客”对应到营销邮件中加入网站或具体页面链接。链接应把感兴趣的人送到相关信息或行动处；它解决到访问题，不等同于已经建立信任或完成购买。
explanation.en: The objectives–strategies table links attracting visitors to including website or specific-page links in marketing emails. The destination should support the relevant information/action; arrival is distinct from established trust or completed purchase.

title.zh: 让访客愿意探索且知道链接去向
title.en: Encourage exploration and make destinations predictable

explanation.zh: 让用户停留探索可用商品评论、比较功能及使用建议；促使用户沿链接寻找信息则需要清楚标签，并提示点击后会得到什么。前者提供有用内容，后者减少导航不确定性。
explanation.en: Product reviews, comparisons and usage advice encourage visitors to stay and explore. Clearly labelled links indicating what lies behind them encourage information seeking. One adds useful content; the other reduces navigation uncertainty.

title.zh: 品牌印象、信息可信与声誉证明
title.en: Brand impression, reliable information and reputation evidence

explanation.zh: 一致品牌印象依靠logo、角色、口号等已有元素；建立信任依靠信息的有效性与客观性；强化既有正面形象可展示评价、奖项及外部评论。三者相互支持，但好看或有口号不能替代可靠事实。
explanation.en: A consistent brand impression uses established logos, characters and slogans. Trust requires valid, objective information, while testimonials, awards and external reviews can reinforce positive reputation. They support one another, but appearance or slogans do not replace reliable facts.

title.zh: 更新信息支持再次访问
title.en: Keep information current to support return visits

explanation.zh: 表中“鼓励返回”对应定期更新组织、商品与服务的当前信息。网站关系并不止于首次获客：目录与内容维护让访客再次访问时仍能获得价值，连接到前面的目录生命周期。
explanation.en: The table connects return visits with regularly updated information about the organisation, products and services. Relationships extend beyond first acquisition: catalog/content maintenance preserves value on later visits, linking back to the catalog lifecycle.

title.zh: 可达性：易找信息、多种路径与双向沟通
title.en: Accessibility goals: findable information, varied paths and two-way communication

explanation.zh: 该页列五个业务网站目标：易获取组织事实、允许不同方式与层次的体验、提供有意义的双向互动、保持注意并鼓励回访、易获取产品/服务及使用方法信息。这是课件的广义可达性清单，不是完整技术无障碍标准。
explanation.en: The slide lists five goals: easy access to organisational facts, varied ways and levels of experience, meaningful two-way interaction, sustained attention/return visits, and easy access to offering/usage information. This is the deck’s broad accessibility checklist, not a complete technical accessibility standard.

relation.zh: 把线上价值进一步转成明确的付费来源
relation.en: Translate online value into identified payer streams

relation.zh: 通过付费事件区分收费子模式
relation.en: Distinguish fee variants through their payment events

relation.zh: 目录销售需要可靠商品信息支撑
relation.en: Catalog sales require dependable product information

relation.zh: 一致有序的数据支持筛选和排序
relation.en: Consistent organised data support filtering and sorting

relation.zh: 找到候选后通过预览与导航继续比较
relation.en: After discovery, previews and navigation support comparison

relation.zh: 连续体验依赖目标、数据、分析和人员协同
relation.en: Continuous experience depends on goals, data, analytics and agents

relation.zh: 整合程度解释渠道演进，而非单纯触点数量
relation.en: Integration explains channel progression beyond touchpoint counts

relation.zh: 触点组合还要检查是否相互连接
relation.en: A touchpoint mix must also be checked for integration

relation.zh: 持续维护保持回访信息的时效
relation.en: Ongoing maintenance keeps return-visit information current

relation.zh: 文件交付还要明确使用权和销售关系
relation.en: File delivery also requires clarity about rights and sales relationships

relation.zh: 数字内容可通过组合与示例降低选择难度
relation.en: Packaging and demonstrations aid digital-content choices

relation.zh: 免费层的价值差异形成持续付费理由
relation.en: Value differences from the free tier create reasons for continuing payment

relation.zh: 广告可以支持免费层，与订阅形成组合
relation.en: Advertising can fund a free tier alongside subscriptions

relation.zh: 广告模型需要区分广告主与发布者的付费角色
relation.en: Advertising models require distinguishing advertiser and publisher roles

relation.zh: 点击与展示是不同计费事件
relation.en: Clicks and impressions are different billable events

relation.zh: 销售分佣与按点击收入的触发条件不同
relation.en: Sales commissions and click revenue have different triggers

relation.zh: 持续收入仍需与利润及单位指标区分
relation.en: Recurring revenue still differs from profit and unit metrics

relation.zh: 结构与交付标签不应混成唯一收入来源
relation.en: Structure and delivery labels do not imply one revenue source

relation.zh: 网站目的与受众决定设计检验任务
relation.en: Site purpose and audience determine design tasks to test

relation.zh: 配色是样式指南中需要一致使用的决策
relation.en: Palette choices are part of consistently applied style rules

relation.zh: 一致配色可与主视觉和行动共同形成特色
relation.en: Consistent colour can combine with imagery and action to build identity

relation.zh: 第一印象要由可信信息支撑才能深化为信任
relation.en: Credible information supports moving from impression toward trust

relation.zh: 到访后用相关信息与清楚导航支持深入了解
relation.en: After arrival, relevant information and clear navigation support exploration

relation.zh: 能理解的信息路径与可靠内容共同支持信任
relation.en: Understandable pathways and reliable content jointly support trust

relation.zh: 保持可信且更新的信息有助持续关系
relation.en: Reliable, updated information supports a continuing relationship

relation.zh: 体验价值落实为找信息、选择路径与沟通等任务
relation.en: Experience value is realised through information, pathways and communication

prompt.zh: 准备上线商店时，应怎样使用图中的“更快交付”优势？
prompt.en: When planning an online store, how should the image’s “faster delivery” benefit be used?

options.zh: 把它作为需要履约流程支持并验证的价值主张
options.en: Treat it as a value proposition requiring fulfilment support and validation

options.zh: 网站上线本身就证明所有产品交付更快
options.en: Launching the site itself proves all products arrive faster

options.zh: 只需提高广告流量即可保证交付速度
options.en: Increasing ad traffic alone guarantees faster delivery

options.zh: 用销售收入增长代替检查交付体验
options.en: Use revenue growth instead of checking delivery experience

explanation.zh: 线上渠道提供机会，实际交付仍依赖流程；流量和收入指标不能单独证明履约速度。
explanation.en: Online channels create opportunities, but delivery depends on operations; traffic and revenue alone do not prove fulfilment speed.

prompt.zh: 一个内容站同时向广告主收费、向读者收订阅费，最贴近哪类？
prompt.en: A content site charges advertisers and also charges readers a subscription. Which category fits best?

options.zh: 只靠Web目录销售实物
options.en: Pure physical-goods web catalog sales

options.zh: 广告—订阅混合模式
options.en: Advertising–subscription mixed

options.zh: 只有按成交抽佣的收费模式
options.en: A commission-only transaction model

options.zh: 只能属于B2B而不可能属于B2C
options.en: It must be B2B and cannot be B2C

explanation.zh: 两种付费来源构成混合模式；B2B/B2C是客户类型，不是收入模型的替代名称。
explanation.en: The two payer streams form a mixed model; B2B/B2C identify customer types, not substitutes for revenue-model categories.

prompt.zh: 平台只在撮合买卖成交后取得交易额的一部分，属于什么？
prompt.en: A platform receives a share only when a facilitated transaction completes. What is this?

options.zh: 按次观看收费
options.en: Pay-per-view

options.zh: 特色展示位置费
options.en: A featured-listing fee

options.zh: 交易佣金
options.en: A transaction commission

options.zh: 固定期间订阅费
options.en: A fixed-period subscription fee

explanation.zh: 佣金以交易为触发；观看、突出展示和持续访问分别对应其他收费对象。
explanation.en: Commission is triggered by a transaction; viewing, prominence and ongoing access correspond to the other charging bases.

prompt.zh: 同一商品在不同页面规格不一致，应优先改善什么？
prompt.en: The same product has conflicting specifications on different pages. What should be improved first?

options.zh: 仅增加广告覆盖范围
options.en: Only advertising reach

options.zh: 仅增加上架商品总数
options.en: Only the number of listed products

options.zh: 仅改变结算按钮颜色
options.en: Only checkout-button colour

options.zh: 目录信息的一致性与维护控制
options.en: Catalog-data consistency and maintenance control

explanation.zh: 问题来自数据不一致，直接影响理解与信任；流量、数量和装饰都不能修复规格冲突。
explanation.en: The problem is inconsistent data, directly affecting comprehension and trust; traffic, quantity and decoration do not repair conflicting specifications.

prompt.zh: 顾客只想看指定尺码、预算内的商品，再按价格排列，应使用什么？
prompt.en: A shopper wants only the right size within budget, then orders those products by price. What is needed?

options.zh: 先筛选，再排序
options.en: Filter first, then sort

options.zh: 只排序，不排除不符商品
options.en: Sort only, without excluding mismatches

options.zh: 只用快速预览替代筛选
options.en: Use quick view instead of filtering

options.zh: 只增加分页数量
options.en: Only increase the number of pages

explanation.zh: 筛选确定符合条件的集合，排序决定集合内的顺序；快速预览与分页解决的是另一类交互。
explanation.en: Filtering defines the matching set; sorting orders that set. Quick view and pagination address different interactions.

prompt.zh: 用户想快速检查几件商品的细节、尽量不打断列表比较，哪项最直接有帮助？
prompt.en: Users want to inspect several products without disrupting list comparison. Which feature most directly helps?

options.zh: 返回顶部
options.en: Back to top

options.zh: 快速预览
options.en: Quick view

options.zh: 按热门程度排序
options.en: Sort by popularity

options.zh: 只显示最高评分商品
options.en: Filter to the highest-rated products

explanation.zh: 快速预览直接提供当前商品细节；返回顶部、排序和筛选分别解决定位、顺序和候选范围。
explanation.en: Quick view directly supplies product details; back-to-top, sorting and filtering address location, order and candidate scope.

prompt.zh: 顾客在网站开始咨询后，到门店仍需重新提供全部信息，最直接暴露什么？
prompt.en: A customer starts online but must repeat all information in store. What does this most directly reveal?

options.zh: 渠道过多，所以不能销售数字商品
options.en: Too many channels to sell digital products

options.zh: 已经形成完整全渠道体验
options.en: A fully integrated omnichannel experience

options.zh: 触点虽多，但跨渠道衔接不足
options.en: Multiple touchpoints but weak cross-channel continuity

options.zh: 问题只在网站是否有广告
options.en: A problem only about whether the site contains ads

explanation.zh: 全渠道要求连接顾客体验；重复说明信息反映渠道割裂，而不是单纯缺少一个渠道。
explanation.en: Omnichannel requires continuity of experience; repeating information indicates silos, not simply a missing channel.

prompt.zh: 公司统一了各渠道logo，却仍按单渠道业绩竞争、分别保存客户记录，缺口主要在哪里？
prompt.en: A firm shares logos across channels but retains competing channel targets and separate customer records. What is missing?

options.zh: 更多相同的品牌图片
options.en: More identical brand images

options.zh: 把各渠道联系方式隐藏起来
options.en: Hiding channel contact information

options.zh: 只允许顾客使用一个渠道
options.en: Restricting customers to one channel

options.zh: 目标激励与客户数据的整合
options.en: Integrated goals/incentives and customer data

explanation.zh: 表中的组织层整合包括激励、数据、分析与人员；品牌一致是必要线索之一，却不能代替业务协同。
explanation.en: The table’s organisational integration includes incentives, data, analytics and agents; brand consistency cannot replace operational coordination.

prompt.zh: 已有统一顾客视图，但不同部门仍在各自职能壁垒内运营，在图中最接近哪一阶段？
prompt.en: A single customer view exists, but departments still operate in functional silos. Which stage is closest in the diagram?

options.zh: 跨渠道
options.en: Cross-channel

options.zh: 单渠道
options.en: Single-channel

options.zh: 完全协调的全渠道
options.en: Fully coordinated omnichannel

options.zh: 只有彼此独立触点的多渠道
options.en: Multichannel with entirely independent touchpoints

explanation.zh: 图中跨渠道已连接品牌和顾客视图，却尚未完成组织协同；全渠道进一步利用该视图协调战略行动。
explanation.en: The diagram’s cross-channel stage connects the brand/customer view but retains silos; omnichannel uses that view for coordinated strategic action.

prompt.zh: 能否用图中的89%留存率，直接推算新增一个渠道后收入必增89%？
prompt.en: Can the illustrated 89% retention be used to conclude one added channel guarantees 89% revenue growth?

options.zh: 可以，因为所有百分数都衡量收入
options.en: Yes, because every percentage measures revenue

options.zh: 不能，留存与收入增长是不同指标，且图中数据不保证个别结果
options.en: No; retention and revenue growth differ, and illustrated data do not guarantee individual results

options.zh: 可以，只要新增的是社交渠道
options.en: Yes, provided the added channel is social

options.zh: 不能，因为留存率只能用于线下业务
options.en: No, because retention applies only to offline business

explanation.zh: 应保留指标、样本和比较口径；留存并非收入增幅，线上业务同样可研究留存。
explanation.en: Preserve metric and comparison context; retention is not revenue growth, and online businesses can also measure retention.

prompt.zh: 门店展示商品、纸质目录引导访问网站，最合理的解释是什么？
prompt.en: A store presents products and a printed catalog directs shoppers online. What is the best interpretation?

options.zh: 只要存在纸质目录就不属于线上业务
options.en: A printed catalog means it cannot be an online business

options.zh: 渠道组合必须全部使用相同媒介
options.en: A channel mix must use only one medium

options.zh: 传统触点与网站共同构成渠道组合
options.en: Traditional touchpoints and the website form a channel mix

options.zh: 两个触点存在就证明数据已自动整合
options.en: Having two touchpoints proves data are automatically integrated

explanation.zh: 渠道组合可以跨媒介；是否形成全渠道还需要数据和体验整合，不能只按触点数量判断。
explanation.en: A mix can cross media; omnichannel status still requires data and experience integration, not merely multiple touchpoints.

prompt.zh: 产品价格与图片不断更新时，哪种安排最符合目录管理图？
prompt.en: When prices and images change continually, which arrangement fits the catalog-management diagram?

options.zh: 首批上传后只管理广告，不再维护目录
options.en: After initial upload, manage only advertising

options.zh: 每个渠道独立随意改写规格以加快发布
options.en: Let channels independently rewrite specifications

options.zh: 把格式转换视为整个目录管理的全部
options.en: Treat format conversion as the entirety of catalog management

options.zh: 将数据、图片、索引及发布纳入持续维护和报告流程
options.en: Include data, images, indexing and publication in ongoing maintenance/reporting

explanation.zh: 图有多类内容处理与外层支撑活动；单项转换或一次上传不能覆盖持续一致的目录运作。
explanation.en: The diagram includes several processing tasks plus supporting activities; one conversion step or one upload cannot cover continuing consistent operation.

prompt.zh: 销售电子书时，哪项最直接属于数字内容交付设计？
prompt.en: When selling ebooks, what most directly concerns digital-content delivery?

options.zh: 说明文件格式以及顾客能在哪些设备阅读
options.en: Specify formats and the devices customers can read on

options.zh: 只展示实体仓库货架位置
options.en: Show only the physical warehouse shelf location

options.zh: 以广告点击数代替说明文件类型
options.en: Substitute ad-click counts for file-type information

options.zh: 只按网站访客数计算每本书价格
options.en: Price each book only by site visitor count

explanation.zh: 格式与设备影响数字内容能否使用；仓库位置和广告流量不能替代数字交付信息。
explanation.en: Formats and devices affect usability of digital content; warehouse location and ad traffic do not replace delivery information.

prompt.zh: 免费层可用部分内容，付费层提供完整访问和附加功能，核心逻辑是什么？
prompt.en: A free tier offers some content while a paid tier offers full access and extra features. What is the core logic?

options.zh: 免费层意味着业务不可能有任何收入
options.en: A free tier makes revenue impossible

options.zh: 通过差异化价值层形成升级理由
options.en: Differentiate value tiers to create reasons to upgrade

options.zh: 所有用户必须从第一天支付同一费用
options.en: Every user must pay the same fee from day one

options.zh: 广告收入必须始终超过订阅收入
options.en: Advertising revenue must always exceed subscriptions

explanation.zh: 免费与付费可以共存；关键是功能/访问价值差异，收入比例依业务而异。
explanation.en: Free and paid tiers can coexist; the key is differentiated functionality/access, while the revenue mix depends on the business.

prompt.zh: 某案例总收入上升但仍报告营业亏损，哪种解释正确？
prompt.en: A case reports rising revenue but an operating loss. Which interpretation is correct?

options.zh: 只要收入上升，营业亏损一定是图表错误
options.en: Rising revenue makes any operating loss a chart error

options.zh: 每用户收入必定与总收入同比例上升
options.en: Revenue per user must rise at the same rate as total revenue

options.zh: 收入增长与是否盈利是不同判断，仍需考虑成本
options.en: Revenue growth and profitability differ; costs still matter

options.zh: 广告占比等同于净利润率
options.en: Advertising share is identical to net profit margin

explanation.zh: 总收入不扣成本，单位收入与来源占比也有各自分母；这些指标不能互相替代。
explanation.en: Revenue is before costs, while unit revenue and source shares have different denominators; these metrics are not interchangeable.

prompt.zh: 买家要把音乐用在商业项目中，卖家应优先明确什么？
prompt.en: A buyer wants to use music in a commercial project. What should the seller clarify first?

options.zh: 只要可下载就自动拥有所有用途权利
options.en: Download access automatically grants every use right

options.zh: 页面颜色能否替代许可说明
options.en: Whether page colour can replace licence terms

options.zh: 网站访客数是否超过某一固定门槛
options.en: Whether site traffic exceeds a fixed threshold

options.zh: 所购买的使用许可与授权范围
options.en: The purchased usage licence and its scope

explanation.zh: 下载或购买文件与获得特定使用权并非同一问题；许可设计对应内容使用场景。
explanation.en: Downloading or purchasing a file is not identical to receiving every usage right; licensing should match the intended use.

prompt.zh: 顾客不确定课程是否适合自己，哪项最直接降低判断难度？
prompt.en: Customers are unsure whether a course suits them. What most directly helps them evaluate it?

options.zh: 提供代表性免费样本，并清楚说明整课与单课选项
options.en: Provide a representative sample and explain full-course versus lesson options

options.zh: 隐藏课程组成，只显示统一价格
options.en: Hide course composition and show one price

options.zh: 用网站总访问量代替课程内容说明
options.en: Replace content information with site-traffic figures

options.zh: 只允许顾客购买所有课程以增加选择自由
options.en: Require purchase of every course to increase choice

explanation.zh: 样本提供内容证据，组合说明帮助选择；流量数字和隐藏结构无法回答适配问题。
explanation.en: Samples provide content evidence and packaging helps selection; traffic figures and hidden structure do not answer suitability questions.

prompt.zh: 品牌支付固定金额赞助一期内容，不随点击或成交数量结算，属于哪项？
prompt.en: A brand pays a fixed amount to sponsor a content edition, independent of clicks or sales. Which model is this?

options.zh: 按点击收费
options.en: Cost per click

options.zh: 固定费用赞助
options.en: Fixed-fee sponsorship

options.zh: 成交佣金
options.en: Sales commission

options.zh: 读者按月订阅
options.en: Reader monthly subscription

explanation.zh: 付款方是赞助商且金额按安排固定；点击、成交或持续用户访问是其他模式的触发条件。
explanation.en: The sponsor pays a fixed arrangement fee; clicks, completed sales or ongoing user access trigger the other models.

prompt.zh: 顾客按月付费访问内容库，而不是每看一次单独付款，主要属于什么？
prompt.en: Customers pay monthly for access to a content library rather than paying per viewing. What is this primarily?

options.zh: 按次观看模式
options.en: Pay-per-view

options.zh: 只按广告点击收费
options.en: Advertising CPC only

options.zh: 订阅模式
options.en: A subscription model

options.zh: 只靠成交抽佣
options.en: Transaction commission only

explanation.zh: 按期间持续访问对应订阅；单次访问、广告点击和平台成交分别构成不同收费依据。
explanation.en: Period-based continuing access is subscription; individual views, ad clicks and platform transactions have different charging bases.

prompt.zh: 按本页的销售型联盟示例，哪一事件触发分佣？
prompt.en: In this slide’s sales-based affiliate example, what triggers commission?

options.zh: 只看到产品图片
options.en: Only viewing the product image

options.zh: 只点击链接但没有购买
options.en: Only clicking without purchasing

options.zh: 推广者每月自动支付订阅费
options.en: The promoter automatically paying a monthly subscription

options.zh: 通过推荐链接完成购买
options.en: Completing a purchase through the referral link

explanation.zh: 图中把点击连接到最终购买，再分配销售额；应与只按点击计费的CPC区分。
explanation.en: The diagram connects the referral click to a completed purchase and sale share; distinguish it from CPC paid solely by click.

prompt.zh: 同一平台同时出现在“按需”和“双边市场”，最合理的解释是什么？
prompt.en: Why might a platform appear under both “on-demand” and “two-sided marketplace”?

options.zh: 前者描述服务获取方式，后者描述参与者结构，两者可以共存
options.en: One describes service delivery and the other participant structure, so they can coexist

options.zh: 任何平台只能有一种商业模式标签，图必然无效
options.en: Every platform can have only one label, making the map invalid

options.zh: 双边市场表示每次必须向两边收相同费用
options.en: Two-sided means charging both sides the same fee every time

options.zh: 按需服务必然只能靠订阅收费
options.en: On-demand service must be funded only by subscriptions

explanation.zh: 图不是互斥的单轴分类；结构、交付与收入来源应分别辨别，不能从一个标签推导唯一收费方式。
explanation.en: The map is not a mutually exclusive single-axis taxonomy; structure, delivery and revenue sources should be distinguished rather than deriving one mandatory fee model.

prompt.zh: 一个平台对用户免费、主要向广告主收费，应怎样理解？
prompt.en: A platform is free to users and earns mainly from advertisers. How should it be understood?

options.zh: 免费用户意味着平台没有收入模型
options.en: Free users mean the platform has no revenue model

options.zh: 用户与主要付款方不同，广告主为接触受众付费
options.en: Users differ from the main payer; advertisers pay to reach the audience

options.zh: 广告主购买的必然是实物商品
options.en: Advertisers must be purchasing physical goods

options.zh: 广告为主意味着不允许其他收入来源
options.en: Advertising dominance prohibits other revenue sources

explanation.zh: 收入分析先识别付款方；平台可同时有多种收入，不能把使用免费等同于没有变现。
explanation.en: Revenue analysis starts with the payer; platforms can combine sources, so free use does not imply no monetisation.

prompt.zh: 按第27页图片，网站所有者提供位置展示他人广告，属于哪一角色？
prompt.en: In slide 27’s image, the site owner provides placement for others’ ads. Which role is this?

options.zh: 购买广告流量的广告主
options.en: Advertiser buying reach

options.zh: 按月购买内容访问的订阅者
options.en: Subscriber purchasing monthly access

options.zh: 广告发布者／publisher
options.en: Ad publisher

options.zh: 出售推荐商品本身的制造商
options.en: Manufacturer selling the referred product itself

explanation.zh: 图片从网站发布者角度解释广告收入；标题与图片品牌不同，角色判断应以实际业务流程为准。
explanation.en: The image explains revenue from the publisher’s perspective; despite the heading/image naming difference, identify roles from the actual workflow.

prompt.zh: 若示例约定CPM为RM8，计费展示25,000次，费用是多少？
prompt.en: If an example agreement sets CPM at RM8 for 25,000 billable impressions, what is the fee?

options.zh: RM8
options.en: RM8

options.zh: RM200
options.en: RM200

explanation.zh: 25,000÷1,000×8=200；CPM的单位是每千次展示，不是每次展示或每次点击。
explanation.en: 25,000 ÷ 1,000 × 8 = 200. CPM is per thousand impressions, not per impression or click.

prompt.zh: 哪一组正确对应课件示例中的计费/分佣事件？
prompt.en: Which correctly maps charging/commission events in the slide examples?

options.zh: CPC—点击；CPM—千次展示；销售型联盟—推荐后成交
options.en: CPC—clicks; CPM—thousand impressions; sales affiliate—referred purchases

options.zh: CPC—购买；CPM—点击；联盟—任何页面浏览
options.en: CPC—purchases; CPM—clicks; affiliate—any page view

options.zh: CPC—千次展示；CPM—订阅；联盟—固定赞助
options.en: CPC—thousand impressions; CPM—subscriptions; affiliate—fixed sponsorship

options.zh: 三者都只根据同一网站的独立访客数
options.en: All three depend only on the site’s unique-visitor count

explanation.zh: 三种模式分别按不同事件结算；不能把曝光、点击和成交当成同一个转化步骤。
explanation.en: They settle on different events; exposure, clicking and purchasing are distinct steps, not interchangeable conversions.

prompt.zh: “自动安排广告购买”与“顾客接近门店时触达”分别更接近什么？
prompt.en: “Automated ad buying” and “contact near a store” respectively align with what?

options.zh: 信标广告；程序化广告
options.en: Beacon; programmatic advertising

options.zh: 程序化广告；信标广告
options.en: Programmatic; beacon advertising

options.zh: CPM；按次观看
options.en: CPM; pay-per-view

options.zh: 联盟分佣；固定赞助
options.en: Affiliate commission; fixed sponsorship

explanation.zh: 两者按投放机制区分；CPM、按次观看等是不同层次的收费或访问方式。
explanation.en: The distinction concerns delivery mechanisms; CPM and pay-per-view describe charging or access at a different level.

prompt.zh: 移动社交页面内可直接点击购买，哪种理解最准确？
prompt.en: A mobile social page includes a direct buy button. Which interpretation is most accurate?

options.zh: 有购买按钮就不再属于社交广告
options.en: A buy button makes it no longer social advertising

options.zh: 移动广告只能按订阅收费
options.en: Mobile advertising can only use subscriptions

options.zh: 设备、渠道与购买交互三个层次组合在一起
options.en: Device, channel and purchase interaction are combined

options.zh: 买按钮本身保证所有点击成为销售
options.en: A buy button guarantees every click becomes a sale

explanation.zh: 这些标签描述不同层次；减少步骤可以改善路径，但不保证成交或限定收费模式。
explanation.en: The labels concern different levels; fewer steps may improve the path but neither guarantee sales nor determine the payment model.

prompt.zh: 广告以接近所在资讯页面的内容形式呈现，最贴近哪项？
prompt.en: An ad is presented in a format resembling the surrounding editorial environment. Which is closest?

options.zh: 信标广告
options.en: Beacon advertising

options.zh: 仅凭格式即可认定为非商业内容
options.en: Noncommercial content determined by format alone

options.zh: 按次观看收费
options.en: Pay-per-view

options.zh: 原生广告
options.en: Native advertising

explanation.zh: 原生描述呈现形式；接近内容样式不改变其广告性质，计费与位置触发也属于不同维度。
explanation.en: Native describes presentation; matching content style does not remove its advertising nature, and charging/proximity are different dimensions.

prompt.zh: 比较新闻站与教育站时，哪种评价更有依据？
prompt.en: Which evaluation is better grounded when comparing news and educational sites?

options.zh: 分别检查事件报道与学习任务是否得到有效支持
options.en: Check how well each supports event reporting and learning tasks respectively

options.zh: 只看是否都采用相同布局
options.en: Judge only whether both use the same layout

options.zh: 所有网站都只按购物车完成率评价
options.en: Evaluate every site only by cart completion

options.zh: 只要有长篇文字就属于教育站
options.en: Classify any long-text site as educational

explanation.zh: 网站类型服务不同任务，设计评价应与任务对应；单一形式或购物指标不能替代目的分析。
explanation.en: Site types serve different tasks, so design evaluation should match them; one visual form or shopping metric cannot replace purpose analysis.

prompt.zh: 一个站点把多个来源的文章集中展示，最直接体现哪一种类型？
prompt.en: A site collects articles from multiple sources for display. Which type is most directly illustrated?

options.zh: 纯Web应用工具
options.en: Pure web application tool

options.zh: 内容聚合网站
options.en: Content aggregator

options.zh: 个人身份介绍页
options.en: Personal profile site

options.zh: 倡议网站
options.en: Advocacy site

explanation.zh: 跨来源内容汇集是聚合的特征；执行工具任务、个人展示和支持议题是不同主要目的。
explanation.en: Bringing together cross-source content defines aggregation; tool execution, personal presentation and cause advocacy have different primary purposes.

prompt.zh: 以多人共同编辑和维护知识条目为核心，最贴近哪种网站？
prompt.en: Which type centres on multiple people collaboratively editing and maintaining knowledge entries?

options.zh: 以个人连续文章为主的博客
options.en: A blog centred on one person’s continuing posts

options.zh: 以个人身份和作品展示为主的网站
options.en: A personal identity/portfolio site

options.zh: Wiki
options.en: Wiki

options.zh: 只展示公司商品与服务的营销站
options.en: A marketing site displaying company offerings

explanation.zh: 协作编辑知识是Wiki的核心机制；博客、个人展示与商业推广的主要组织逻辑不同。
explanation.en: Collaborative knowledge editing is the key wiki mechanism; blogs, personal presentation and commercial promotion use different organising logic.

prompt.zh: 以用户关系、互相交流为核心，而不是以某位作者的连续文章为核心，最贴近什么？
prompt.en: A site centres on user relationships and interaction rather than one author’s continuing posts. Which type is closest?

options.zh: 个人博客
options.en: Personal blog

options.zh: 静态个人作品展示
options.en: Static personal portfolio

options.zh: 只聚合外部新闻的页面
options.en: A page only aggregating external news

options.zh: 在线社交网络
options.en: Online social network

explanation.zh: 区别在参与机制：社交网络围绕用户之间的关系，博客围绕发布者的文章序列；二者可以共享某些界面功能。
explanation.en: The distinction is participation: a network centres on relationships among users, while a blog centres on a publisher’s post sequence, even if some interface features overlap.

prompt.zh: 用户主要在浏览器里编辑文件并完成任务，最直接属于哪类？
prompt.en: Users mainly edit files and complete tasks in the browser. Which type most directly fits?

options.zh: Web应用
options.en: Web application

options.zh: 新闻报道网站
options.en: News site

options.zh: 只展示个人简介的网站
options.en: Personal biography site

options.zh: 只汇集文章来源的聚合页
options.en: An article-source aggregation page

explanation.zh: 任务执行与交互功能是Web应用的核心；它可以商业化，但收入方式与网站功能类型仍需区分。
explanation.en: Task execution and interactive functionality are central to a web application; it may be commercial, but monetisation and functional site type remain distinct.

prompt.zh: 公司想提升网站初次访问时的可信度，应怎样理解该页？
prompt.en: A firm wants to improve credibility on first visits. How should the slide be interpreted?

options.zh: 只要达到图中的百分比，任何设计都会成功
options.en: Any design succeeds once the illustrated percentage is reached

options.zh: 检查设计是否清楚、专业并支持顾客了解业务
options.en: Examine whether design is clear, professional and helps customers understand the business

options.zh: 网站设计与购买前信息研究完全无关
options.en: Design is unrelated to pre-purchase research

options.zh: 把三项百分比相加得到购买成功率
options.en: Add the three percentages to obtain a purchase-success rate

explanation.zh: 图中的百分比对应不同问题，不能相加成转化率；可采取的方向是改善访问者的理解与信任。
explanation.en: The percentages address different questions and cannot be summed into conversion; the actionable direction is improved understanding and trust.

prompt.zh: 重新设计结算流程后，哪种证据更能检验体验是否改善？
prompt.en: After redesigning checkout, what better evaluates whether experience improved?

options.zh: 直接把投入乘以100作为已经实现的回报
options.en: Multiply spending by 100 and record it as realised return

options.zh: 只计算新页面使用了多少种颜色
options.en: Count only how many colours the new pages use

options.zh: 观察用户是否更顺利地理解并完成购买任务
options.en: Observe whether users understand and complete purchasing more successfully

options.zh: 只检查页面是否比原来更长
options.en: Check only whether pages are longer than before

explanation.zh: 用户体验应连接任务结果；课件的宽泛回报宣称不是对项目的实测值，装饰数量也不是体验成果。
explanation.en: UX should connect to task outcomes; the broad return claim is not a measured result for the project, and decoration counts are not experience outcomes.

prompt.zh: 同类按钮在各页面的悬停与选中状态完全不同，应如何改善？
prompt.en: Equivalent buttons show unrelated hover/selected states across pages. What should improve them?

options.zh: 让所有文本都看起来像按钮
options.en: Make all text look like buttons

options.zh: 只更换logo而不统一控件行为线索
options.en: Only change the logo without aligning control cues

options.zh: 取消全部状态差异以追求一致
options.en: Remove all state differences in pursuit of consistency

options.zh: 用共同样式指南定义相同角色与状态的规则
options.en: Use shared style-guide rules for equivalent roles and states

explanation.zh: 一致性要保持同一角色规则，同时保留状态与层级区别；不是把所有元素压成同一种外观。
explanation.en: Consistency preserves rules for equivalent roles while retaining state and hierarchy distinctions; it is not visual uniformity for every element.

prompt.zh: 设计者依据色轮决定所有购买按钮必须用红色并保证销量提高，问题是什么？
prompt.en: A designer uses the colour wheel to claim all buy buttons must be red and sales are guaranteed to rise. What is the problem?

options.zh: 图只提示配色选择，没有给出颜色与必然销量的规则
options.en: The figure prompts palette choices but establishes no guaranteed colour–sales rule

options.zh: 网站设计完全不需要考虑颜色
options.en: Website design never needs colour choices

options.zh: 样式指南只适用于纸质目录
options.en: Style guides apply only to printed catalogs

options.zh: 只要所有颜色不同，就一定更易使用
options.en: Different colours for every element necessarily improve usability

explanation.zh: 配色要服务品牌、可读性与一致性；该页没有可支持绝对转化承诺的证据。
explanation.en: Colour should serve brand, readability and consistency; the slide provides no evidence for an absolute conversion promise.

prompt.zh: 哪种做法更符合这张截图对“突出特色”的示范？
prompt.en: Which approach best matches the screenshot’s demonstration of distinctiveness?

options.zh: 为了独特而隐藏导航与搜索
options.en: Hide navigation and search to be distinctive

options.zh: 把品牌主视觉、清楚价值表达与明确购买入口结合
options.en: Combine distinctive imagery, a clear value message and an obvious shopping action

options.zh: 只增加动画，移除商品信息
options.en: Add animation while removing product information

options.zh: 复制竞争者每个细节即可自动形成辨识度
options.en: Copy every competitor detail to guarantee distinctiveness

explanation.zh: 图中视觉特色和清楚行动并存；差异化不能以阻碍找货和理解为代价。
explanation.en: The screenshot combines visual identity and clear action; differentiation should not obstruct discovery or understanding.

prompt.zh: 目标顾客主要用手机，设计验收应优先包含什么？
prompt.en: Target customers mainly use phones. What should design acceptance especially include?

options.zh: 只检查大屏电脑截图是否漂亮
options.en: Check only attractive desktop screenshots

options.zh: 把电脑页面等比例截图当作所有手机体验
options.en: Treat a scaled desktop screenshot as the entire mobile experience

options.zh: 在手机上验证实际浏览、理解与购买任务
options.en: Validate real browsing, comprehension and purchasing tasks on phones

options.zh: 只统计采用了多少新技术名称
options.en: Count only the number of new technology names

explanation.zh: 设计应服务真实受众和使用条件；静态截图或技术清单不能代替任务体验检查。
explanation.en: Design should serve the actual audience and conditions; static screenshots or technology lists do not replace task checks.

prompt.zh: 营销邮件介绍某款商品，哪种策略最直接支持吸引相关访客？
prompt.en: A marketing email introduces one product. Which strategy most directly attracts relevant visitors?

options.zh: 只在页面上展示公司获奖记录而不提供入口
options.en: Show awards without an access link

options.zh: 仅把后台目录格式转换为另一种格式
options.en: Only convert the back-office catalog format

options.zh: 先改变订阅价再判断是否需要链接
options.en: Change subscription price before deciding whether to link

options.zh: 提供通往相关网站页面的明确链接
options.en: Provide a clear link to the relevant site page

explanation.zh: 该目标的直接策略是把营销触点连接到网站；奖项、格式和价格可能服务其他目的，但不提供这里所需的入口。
explanation.en: The direct strategy connects the marketing touchpoint to the site; awards, formats and prices may serve other purposes but do not supply this entry point.

prompt.zh: 用户不知道“点击这里”会打开什么，最直接应改善什么？
prompt.en: Users cannot tell what “click here” opens. What should be improved most directly?

options.zh: 用能预示目标信息的清楚链接标签
options.en: Use clear link labels that preview destination information

options.zh: 仅增加更多不带说明的链接
options.en: Add more unexplained links

options.zh: 把所有商品评论移除以减少文字
options.en: Remove all reviews to reduce text

options.zh: 只把品牌logo放大
options.en: Only enlarge the brand logo

explanation.zh: 问题是链接的信息线索不足；更多同样模糊的入口和视觉放大都不能解释去向。
explanation.en: The problem is insufficient link information; more ambiguous links and larger visuals do not explain destinations.

prompt.zh: 访客已到达商品区，却缺少理由继续了解，表中哪组策略更直接？
prompt.en: Visitors reach products but lack reasons to explore further. Which table strategy is more direct?

options.zh: 只发送更多邮件链接
options.en: Only send more email links

options.zh: 提供评论、比较功能与使用建议
options.en: Offer reviews, comparison features and usage advice

options.zh: 只调整CPM单价
options.en: Only adjust the CPM price

options.zh: 隐藏商品说明以制造悬念
options.en: Hide descriptions to create suspense

explanation.zh: 这些内容帮助访客判断和使用产品，直接服务停留探索；引流或计费调整不等于改善站内信息价值。
explanation.en: These resources help visitors evaluate and use products, directly supporting exploration; acquisition and pricing changes do not add on-site information value.

prompt.zh: 页面视觉一致但产品说法缺少依据，最直接缺少哪项信任策略？
prompt.en: A visually consistent page makes unsupported product claims. Which trust strategy is most directly missing?

options.zh: 只把logo在更多位置重复
options.en: Only repeat the logo in more places

options.zh: 仅增大口号字体
options.en: Only enlarge slogan text

options.zh: 确保信息有效、客观且可依赖
options.en: Ensure valid, objective and dependable information

options.zh: 把所有外部评论替换为品牌颜色
options.en: Replace external reviews with brand colours

explanation.zh: 品牌一致与事实可信是不同目标；重复视觉元素不能弥补信息质量问题。
explanation.en: Brand consistency and factual credibility are different objectives; repeated visuals cannot compensate for weak information quality.

prompt.zh: 公司要强化访客已有的正面印象，表中哪项最匹配？
prompt.en: To reinforce an existing positive impression, which strategy best matches the table?

options.zh: 只为每条链接使用相同的“更多”文字
options.en: Label every link simply “more”

options.zh: 用浏览量代替产品事实说明
options.en: Replace product facts with traffic counts

options.zh: 仅增加广告展示次数
options.en: Only increase ad impressions

options.zh: 提供真实评价、奖项信息与相关外部评论
options.en: Provide testimonials, award information and relevant external reviews

explanation.zh: 表把声誉证明与强化正面印象对应；链接标签、流量和广告曝光并不是同一证据。
explanation.en: The table pairs reputation evidence with reinforcing positive impressions; link labels, traffic and exposure are not equivalent evidence.

prompt.zh: 哪项最直接对应“鼓励访客再次访问”的目标？
prompt.en: Which action most directly matches the objective of encouraging return visits?

options.zh: 持续提供并更新相关的当前信息
options.en: Provide and regularly update relevant current information

options.zh: 只在上线当天发布一次资料
options.en: Publish information only once at launch

options.zh: 保留过期价格以免改变页面
options.en: Keep expired prices to avoid page changes

options.zh: 仅记录第一次邮件点击数
options.en: Only count initial email clicks

explanation.zh: 再次访问需要持续价值和时效；一次发布、过期信息或首次引流指标不足以支持该目标。
explanation.en: Return visits need continuing value and currency; a single publication, stale information or initial acquisition metrics do not fulfil that aim.

prompt.zh: 网站介绍和产品资料齐全，但访客无法向企业提出问题或获得回应，最直接缺哪项目标？
prompt.en: A site has organisation and product information but no way to ask questions and receive responses. Which goal is most directly missing?

options.zh: 只有更多单向宣传内容
options.en: Merely more one-way promotional content

options.zh: 有意义的双向互动沟通
options.en: Meaningful two-way interactive communication

options.zh: 只能采用一种浏览路径
options.en: Restricting visitors to one browsing path

options.zh: 必须改为按次观看收费
options.en: A mandatory change to pay-per-view

explanation.zh: 信息可获取与双向交流是不同目标；增加单向内容不能自动建立互动渠道。
explanation.en: Information availability and two-way communication are distinct goals; adding one-way content does not automatically create interaction.

prompt.zh: 新访客想看概览，熟悉产品的顾客想查详细用法，应怎样设计？
prompt.en: New visitors want an overview while experienced customers want detailed usage guidance. How should the site respond?

options.zh: 所有人必须先完整读完同一长页
options.en: Require everyone to read the same entire long page

options.zh: 只提供概览，删除所有详细信息
options.en: Provide only an overview and remove details

options.zh: 提供不同深度的信息路径，并以目标受众任务检验可用性
options.en: Provide paths at different depths and test usability against audience tasks

options.zh: 只提供技术细节而不允许快速了解
options.en: Provide only technical detail without a quick overview

explanation.zh: 课件要求不同方式和层次的体验，同时让产品与使用信息容易获取；受众不同不意味着只能选一种深度。
explanation.en: The slides call for different ways/levels of experience and easy access to usage information; different audiences do not require one universal depth.

reason.zh: 章节标题与授课者信息；主题按标题Week 4保留，不以文件名误判。
reason.en: Chapter title and lecturer information; the Week 4 title is retained rather than inferred from the filename.

reason.zh: 学习目标预告；收入、渠道、设计及顾客连接已在实质页展开。
reason.en: Learning-objective previews; revenue, channels, design and customer connections are covered on substantive slides.
